title: Connect cards with dependency arrows
text: Draw dependencies directly between cards using dots that appear as the pointer approaches. A ghost arrow follows the pointer and snaps to its target; the dependent card then waits for its prerequisite. Manual arrows can be removed after confirmation, while projects keep the ordering decided from their plans.
chapters: Project ordering stays with the plan

more.title: Choose the target edge
more.text: Move the pointer around a target card to attach a dependency arrow to its nearest edge. The connection keeps the chosen attachment points when the page reloads or the cards move, and can still be removed from the arrow.

more.title: Queue connected cards
more.text: Connect cards to specify which work comes first. Starting a dependent card puts it in the queue until its prerequisites are finished. You can still start it early after confirming a warning.
